name: Home inventory (profile: inventory)
info:
Start the edge with ./start.sh --profile inventory.
Each 'New appliance' becomes an inventory record, POSTed to DigitalHome.cloud: set the environment variable
DHC_API (e.g. https://<your platform>/api) for the real one; without it the record goes to the mock endpoint
below (POST /dhc-mock/inventory on this Node-RED), which answers with an id.
